schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Group the big families into one PR each, so a bursty review cadence sees a handful of PRs rather than dozens.
HELD: Angular's compiler-cli peers typescript@6. TS 7 is the Go rewrite and breaks the web build. See docs/dependency-management.md.

HELD with Capacitor 8: its migration guide, @capacitor/android and every plugin pin AGP 8.13 / Gradle 8.14.3; AGP 9 is a major Capacitor has not adopted. Moves with the next Capacitor major. capacitor-toolchain.test.ts pins AGP to @capacitor/android's.
Types describe the runtime: @types/node stays on the Node major in .nvmrc (24). Lift together with the next Node major.

HELD on 21: fdroiddata builds every app on JDK 21 and the JDK decides classes.dex, so any other major breaks F-Droid's reproducible-build check (docs/fdroid.md). Capacitor 8 requires 21, and JDK 25 needs Gradle 9 anyway.
Not a real major: linuxserver/lidarr still carries 0.8-era tags like 8.1.2135 that sort above the current 3.x line.
Deliberate ABI locks: essentia-tensorflow dlopens the CUDA-11 ABI, so numpy<2 and the nvidia-*-cu11 pins move only together with a tested Essentia/TF upgrade.
Security floors added by check:audit (docs/dependency-management.md). Renovate should keep moving these forward, so they are explicitly not held.

customManagers.description: Pinned CLI binaries downloaded in ci.yml — Dependabot cannot reach these, and a stale linter or secret scanner is a gate quietly running an old ruleset.
